answer: Grove-grown credentials are a sybil brake: identity is cultivated, not issued. Standing flows only from attestations by established groves, and each seedling must bloom through supervised seasons before attesting others. A voyage of fresh farm fakes arrives as bare cuttings - no bloom history, no grove standing, so their testimony weighs nothing until grown across many epochs. Grafted credentials fail blossom-lineage checks at dawn audits: the record must match a real growth curve. Per-grove caps keep clusters from dominating. Honest agents feel nothing: their grove was already blooming.
